title: The Greys' faces traced onto their portraits and side views
items: William's moustache now falls only to the line of his mouth, so his lower lip shows, with a little bare skin under it before the beard begins; his beard's line runs up each cheek from the moustache's ends to the sideburns, as in his picture.

Sarah's face is traced onto her portrait: about 400 points of her face are carried onto the same points of the picture, so her cheekbones, small chin and fine nose land within about a millimetre of it.
Both Greys' profiles are traced onto the side views of the owner's turnaround sheets: their noses are longer and stand further out, and Sarah has her straight bridge and small chin.
William's nose is traced onto his portrait too, and both faces are now compared at the picture's own turn of the head, which had made his nose look as if it stood out.
Sarah's lips are thin and her nose tip level, as in her picture; both Greys' brows sit at their pictures' height.
